projects.name: Bezent Ecosystem (HRMS & PMS)
projects.description: Enterprise multi-tenant HRMS & Project Management System (PMS) covering attendance, employee records, tenant administration, and workflow automations.
projects.technology: Node.js, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, MySQL 8.4, React
projects.notes: Local dev database configured on MySQL 8.4 (BEZENT-MySQL84). Developing HRMS modules and PMS roadmap.

projects.name: Project Tracker SaaS
projects.description: Modern luxury deep-green project, task, and time telemetry suite with native MCP AI automation for Antigravity and Claude Code.
projects.technology: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Spring Boot, Neon PostgreSQL, Node.js MCP
projects.notes: Luxury Deep Green · Electric Lime UI, native MCP server, resilient local storage, and Neon PostgreSQL schema.

tasks.title: MySQL 8.4 DB setup and Drizzle ORM migrations
tasks.description: Configure local mysqld datadir at C:/ProgramData/MySQL/bezent_dev_data and run drizzle migrations.

tasks.title: Attendance module location & security verification
tasks.description: Implement geofenced attendance capture, shift rules, and tamper verification.

tasks.title: Tenant Profile & Multi-company onboarding wizard
tasks.description: Complete Company Details, Tenant Profile, and Administration dashboard atlas.

tasks.title: BEZENT PMS workflow architecture benchmark
tasks.description: Structure Project Manager (PM) and Project Lead (PL) workflow specification maps.

tasks.title: Employee records reference and changes audit
tasks.description: Build employee profile history tracking, document uploads, and HRMS verification.

tasks.title: Luxury Electric Lime & Dark Forest UI Redesign
tasks.description: Elevated all core workspaces (Dashboard, Projects, My Tasks, Calendar) to a luxury executive dark theme with chartreuse highlights and blackened forest surfaces.

tasks.title: Spring Boot REST API & Neon PostgreSQL Entity Mappings
tasks.description: Implemented Spring Boot JPA repositories, REST controllers for Dashboard, Projects, Tasks, and Jackson array serializers for Neon Cloud PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Flyway Database Migration Pipeline (V1-V4)
tasks.description: Automated database schema versioning with Flyway scripts covering projects, tasks, milestones, activities, and time logs.

tasks.title: Full-Featured My Tasks & Interactive Kanban Workspace
tasks.description: Built dual-view task management: sortable structured table and 4-column drag/click Kanban board with priority filtering and status tracking.

tasks.title: Full-Width 7-Column Calendar & Sprint Deadline Hub
tasks.description: Engineered multi-view calendar (Month, Week, Agenda) with responsive 7-column flex/grid layouts, milestone checkpoint highlights, and day-agenda drawer.

tasks.title: Offline-First Resilient Storage Engine & JSON Backup/Restore
tasks.description: Engineered browser LocalStorage engine with automatic fallback when offline, plus instant JSON snapshot export and restore.

tasks.title: Native Stdio MCP Server for Antigravity & Claude Code Automation
tasks.description: Implemented autonomous Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (mcp-server/index.mjs) registered globally in ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json with 10 tools.

tasks.title: Workspace Purge & Real Projects Integration (Bezent + Tracker)
tasks.description: Cleaned legacy demo data, integrated Bezent Ecosystem HRMS & PMS as primary sibling project, and streamlined navigation/sidebar.

tasks.title: Automated Git Hook Telemetry & Work Session Logger
tasks.description: Background daemon logger that automatically captures git commit messages, file edits, and active coding sessions into the tracker.

tasks.title: Live Neon Cloud PostgreSQL Production Deployment
tasks.description: Deploy Spring Boot service to cloud hosting and establish live PostgreSQL sync bridge.
